EVAL-F-3-S1.title: Facade Input/Output Schema and Contract Definition
EVAL-F-3-S1.description: Define canonical request/response schemas including unified envelope (status, data, errors, metadata) with explicit extensibility hooks for additional Evaluate Care domains beyond trials and provider detail.

EVAL-F-3-S2.title: Core Orchestration Logic for Trials and Provider Detail
EVAL-F-3-S2.description: Implement facade orchestration logic routing to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, supporting parallel execution where applicable, aggregation rules, and normalization into unified schema envelope.

EVAL-F-3-S3.title: Tool Router Integration for Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-3-S3.description: Expose facade via tool_router with explicit allowlisted tool definitions (evaluate_trials, evaluate_provider_detail) including request/response contract alignment to unified schema, strict Pydantic validation, and compatibility with main.py agent loop and future Evaluate Care domain extensions.

EVAL-F-3-S4.title: Facade Error Handling and Response Normalization
EVAL-F-3-S4.description: Implement shared error taxonomy and normalization layer including standardized error codes, partial success handling, and fallback behavior across clinical trials and provider detail domains.

EVAL-F-3-S5.title: Facade Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F-3-S5.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, orchestration paths, tool_router invocation, partial failures, and cross-domain response consistency for trials and provider detail flows.
